_note: v2 hooks for Maisons de prière (B43). faiths1: courtyard + synagogue + mosque. Respectful; plain/reverent hooks. faiths1b: paintings repainted so every box frames its item.

fr_religion_noun.hook: Reverent: like "religion", said ruh-lee-ZHYOHN: people of many faiths gather peacefully in the shared courtyard.

fr_pagode_noun.hook: Reverent: like "pagoda", said pah-GOD: a tiered PAGODA with golden bells.

fr_chretien_adj.hook: Reverent: linked to "Christian", said kray-TYAN: two CHRISTIAN children walk across the courtyard toward the chapel.

fr_orthodoxe_adj.hook: Reverent: like "Orthodox", said or-toh-DOKS: golden ORTHODOX onion domes rise behind the courtyard.

fr_temple_noun.hook: Reverent: linked to "temple", said TAHNPL: a quiet white PROTESTANT CHURCH, or temple, with a simple cross on the roof.

fr_pasteur_noun.hook: Reverent: a kind PASTOR in a black gown with white bands reads from the Bible at the chapel door.

fr_protestant_noun.hook: Reverent: like "protestant", said proh-tehs-TAHN: a PROTESTANT man arrives with his Bible under his arm.
fr_protestant_noun.why: faiths1b; person distinct from temple building

fr_culte_noun.hook: Reverent: linked to "cult", said KEWLT: a congregation sits on wooden benches for Sunday WORSHIP.

fr_christianisme_noun.hook: Reverent: like "christianity", said krees-tyah-NEEZM: a small stone shrine bears a simple cross of CHRISTIANITY.

fr_synagogue_noun.hook: Reverent: like "synagogue", said see-nah-GOG: a framed picture of a SYNAGOGUE facade hangs on the sanctuary wall.

fr_kippa_noun.hook: Reverent: like "kippah", said kee-PAH: a knitted KIPPAH skullcap rests on a prayer book.

fr_torah_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Torah", said toh-RAH: a boy reads the TORAH scroll at the bimah with a silver pointer.

fr_mezouza_noun.hook: Reverent: like "mezuzah", said may-zoo-ZAH: a small MEZUZAH case is fixed on the doorpost.

fr_menorah_noun.hook: Reverent: like "menorah", said muh-noh-RAH: a silver MENORAH with seven branches.

fr_etoile_de_david_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Star of David", said ay-TWAHL duh dah-VEED: a carved golden STAR OF DAVID on the front of the bimah.

fr_juif_adj.hook: Reverent: a JEWISH family lights Shabbat candles together on a Friday evening.

fr_rabbin_noun.hook: Reverent: like "rabbi", said rah-BAN: an elderly RABBI studies a thick book by the window.

fr_talmud_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Talmud", said tahl-MEWD: a thick bound TALMUD volume open on a study desk.

fr_tallit_noun.hook: Reverent: like "tallit", said tah-LEET: a white TALLIT prayer shawl with dark stripes hangs over a pew.

fr_shofar_noun.hook: Reverent: like "shofar", said shoh-FAHR: a curved ram's-horn SHOFAR rests on a cushion.

fr_shabbat_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Sabbath", said shah-BAH: two candles glow on a table set for the SABBATH meal.

fr_mosquee_noun.hook: Reverent: like "mosque", said mohs-KAY: a framed picture of a green-domed MOSQUE hangs in the prayer hall.

fr_musulman_adj.hook: Reverent: linked to "Muslim", said mew-zewl-MAHN: a MUSLIM man kneels with his hands raised in quiet prayer.

fr_hallal_adj.hook: Reverent: like "halal", said ah-LAHL: bread and dates on the little table are HALAL, permitted food.

fr_islam_noun.hook: Reverent: like "islam", said ee-SLAHM: an eight-pointed star panel of the art of ISLAM decorates the wall.

fr_coran_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Qur'an", said koh-RAHN: a beautifully bound QUR'AN rests on a carved wooden stand.

fr_imam_noun.hook: Reverent: like "imam", said ee-MAHM: an IMAM prays quietly before the mihrab.

fr_minaret_noun.hook: Reverent: like "minaret", said mee-nah-REH: a slender MINARET rises against the sky beyond the window.

fr_mihrab_noun.hook: Reverent: like "mihrab", said mee-RAHB: an ornate arched MIHRAB niche marks the direction of prayer.

fr_minbar_noun.hook: Reverent: like "minbar", said meen-BAHR: a wooden MINBAR pulpit with a short stair.

fr_muezzin_noun.hook: Reverent: like "muezzin", said mweh-ZEN: the MUEZZIN calls to prayer from the high window, hands raised to his mouth.

fr_tapis_de_priere_noun.hook: Reverent: a neatly rolled PRAYER RUG leans against the wooden minbar.

fr_ramadan_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Ramadan", said rah-mah-DAHN: dates, water and a crescent lantern wait to break the RAMADAN fast at sunset.
